speaker: A
text: Morning Dave, it's Sam at Sample Kitchen. This call's recorded for our order records, is that OK?

speaker: B
text: No problem Sam. What can I get you for Thursday?

speaker: A
text: Twenty kilos of chicken thighs please. What's the price this week?

speaker: B
text: Thighs have gone up. They're six ninety a kilo now.

speaker: A
text: Six ninety? I paid six forty last week, and Northgate are doing them at six ten. Can you match six forty?

speaker: B
text: Go on then, six forty a kilo for you this week.

speaker: A
text: Thank you. And ten kilos of brown onions.

speaker: B
text: Onions are eighty five pence a kilo, same as last time. All on the van Thursday morning.
